description: Source code for the QuicServer class implementing a QUIC protocol server, including socket creation, event handling, and dispatcher management.

classes.name: quic::QuicServer
classes.description: Implements a QUIC protocol server with socket management, event handling, and dispatcher creation.

methods.name: QuicServer
methods.description: Constructors initializing the server with various configurations.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets flow control windows and adds default crypto config.

methods.name: CreateUDPSocketAndListen
methods.description: Creates UDP socket, binds, and registers it for event handling.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Creates a packet writer for the socket.

methods.name: CreateQuicDispatcher
methods.description: Creates and returns a new dispatcher for handling QUIC sessions.

methods.name: CreateEventLoop
methods.description: Creates and returns a new event loop.

methods.name: WaitForEvents
methods.description: Runs the event loop once with a timeout.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the server, dispatcher, and event loop.
